title: if / else
instructions: An if statement lets your program make a decision. If a condition is true, it runs the code in its { } braces.
Add else if to check more conditions, and else as a catch-all when nothing above matched.
The computer checks them top to bottom and runs the FIRST one that is true, then skips the rest.
The condition uses the comparison operators you learned: >=, ==, <, and so on.
task: Fill in the condition so a score of 75 prints:  Grade: C
